dct_description_sm: This project evaluated the effect of Anuew (prohexadione-calcium) as compared with industry standard, Primo Maxx (trinexapac-ethyl) and experimental NAI-20026 (trinexepac-ethyl) on turfgrass growth and quality parameters on a mature bentgrass/annual bluegrass greens height stand of turf. Performance was assessed by how the treatments impacted turfgrass growth (clipping biomass), any stress if observed, and associated turfgrass quality measures.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Comparing plant growth regulators: Anuew, Primo Maxx and an experimental on a USGA putting green
